canDo: Can use y/en naturally in common à/de/quantity structures and recognise what common verbs take.
review: Review COD/COI; learn common verbes + à/de and connect them with y/en.
input: Listening: shopping/city life; reading: menus, services and everyday texts.
output: Write 110 words on the city or food with at least 4 uses of y/en; quick spoken replacements.
checkpoint: Complete 12 replacements; be able to explain the difference between y/en, lui/leur and the verb’s preposition.
challenge: Today’s challenge: list in French the food you bought this week and the places you went to; write 6 sentences, at least 4 with y or en (J’en ai acheté deux kilos. / J’y vais le samedi.); then find a short TV5MONDE video about a market or food and note 3 expressions of quantity.
